defects.title: AC-1.1/AC-1.2 require a contract for /sc:load, which the spec says writes none
defects.quote: the test asserts that every command in sections 3.1-3.2 has a `## Unattended mode` section naming `return-contract.yaml` and `~/.claude/WORKER-CONTRACT.md`
defects.what_goes_wrong: load is a section 3.2 P1 command whose row (line 112) and Decision (line 265) give it no report file and only a usage-line fix, so AC-1.1 (section naming return-contract.yaml) and AC-1.2 (7.2 steps 3-4 need a written contract) cannot pass unless the implementer adds the report file the Decision rejects, and P1 cannot close (line 167).
defects.is_fixed_when: The spec states one consistent treatment of /sc:load: either AC-1.1, AC-1.2 and the P1 flag scope explicitly exclude load (it keeps only its usage-line fix), or the load row, P1 scope and the Decisions row all give load a contract that the checks then test.
defects.deletion_note: Deleting AC-1.1 or AC-1.2 entirely is not a fix (P1 would lose its contract checks); removing load from the 3.1-3.2 populations those checks iterate (or moving load out of section 3.2) is a fix.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Section 3 intro (line 76) 'Every changed command also gains the section', P1 scope (line 159), AC-1.2 (line 196), WC-4 'every outcome' (line 62), Decisions row (line 265), section 4 coordinator-side note (line 139); validate-tests row (line 125) also names no contract and needs the same check (gid 232).

defects.title: P1 gate AC-1.1 and flag scope cover P2-P4 commands and pr-submit under D3(a)
defects.quote: the `--unattended` flag accepted by every command in sections 3.1 and 3.2 (a no-op where a command has no gate)
defects.what_goes_wrong: AC-1.1 is a P1 check over all 37 section 3.1-3.2 commands while P1's Commands column edits 13 and the rows assign implement, post-release and pr-submit to P4 (pending D2-D4, with D3(a) recommending no pr-submit changes and coordinator-only use), so an implementer following the phase rows fails AC-1.1 in P1 and later phases cannot start (line 154), or else edits P2-P4 commands in P1 against the phase order and D3(a).
defects.is_fixed_when: The set of commands AC-1.1 (and the P1 flag sentence) asserts in P1 equals the set P1 actually edits, later-phase commands are asserted in their own phase's checks, and pr-submit's section requirement is made conditional on D3(b) (or pr-submit is excluded under D3(a)).
defects.deletion_note: No: deleting AC-1.1 removes the only static check of the section; narrowing its population per phase (deleting the over-broad 'every command in sections 3.1-3.2' wording) is a fix.
defects.present_in_others_hint: P1 scope row (line 159), section 3 phase column (lines 98-125), section 6 intro (line 154), section 4 note on pr-submit (line 139), D3 (lines 237-241), section 9 intro (line 225); also the interim state where --unattended is accepted on gated P2/P4 commands before their gates are resolved (WC-2 line 60, WC-9).

defects.title: brainstorm and init-lite are in no phase yet AC-1.1 requires their section
defects.quote: The only command changes are the small fixes in the last column.
defects.what_goes_wrong: Section 3.1 says ready commands change only by their small fix, brainstorm and init-lite have fix 'None' and appear in no phase's Commands cell, so an implementer following section 6 never edits them and AC-1.1 (every 3.1-3.2 command has the section naming return-contract.yaml) fails; init-lite also has only a `--output <file>` and no output directory for the WC-4 contract.
defects.is_fixed_when: Brainstorm and init-lite are either assigned to a phase that adds the Unattended mode section and the flag (with init-lite given a defined contract location), or explicitly excluded from AC-1.1's population, and the section 3.1 intro no longer says the small fix is the only change if a section is required.
defects.deletion_note: No for AC-1.1 itself; yes if the fix is to narrow AC-1.1 to exclude these two by name and that is stated, since they need no gate change.
defects.present_in_others_hint: Section 3.1 intro (line 79) and rows (lines 84, 87), section 3 intro (line 76), P1 scope (line 159), WC-4 output-dir definition (line 62).

extra_noticed.title: AC-0.4 requires 7.2 step 3, which needs the WC-4 contract that arrives only in P1
extra_noticed.quote: steps 1-3 and 5-7 pass; step 4 uses the command's existing report file, since the contract arrives in P1
extra_noticed.what_goes_wrong: 7.2 step 3 passes only if the worker_done report path is the WC-4 contract path and the outcome matches the contract status, but in P0 no command writes that contract, so AC-0.4 cannot pass and every later phase is blocked (raised as a secondary claim inside gids 252 and 256).
extra_noticed.is_fixed_when: AC-0.4 also exempts or rewrites step 3 for P0 (report path and status checked against the command's existing report file).
extra_noticed.deletion_note: No: deleting AC-0.4 removes the P0 smoke test that closes evidence gap 1.4.
